d: As the 2026 US midterms approach, Gen Z Indian Americans are reshaping politics, challenging anti-immigrant rhetoric and prioritising affordability, healthcare and climate change. From Zohran Mamdani’s appeal to the future of the Trump-Modi relationship, young Desis are redefining political identity. Meanwhile, Anthropic’s potential trillion-dollar IPO exposes Silicon Valley’s AI paradox: while warning that advanced AI could threaten humanity, the Claude-maker is preparing to cash in on the boom. As young voters challenge the political status quo and AI doomsday becomes an investment…
